data.evolution: Built as a complete Overwatch-style support hero in one cohesive design: full humanoid skeleton with 5-digit cybernetic hands, articulated jaw, dorsal wing chains, hip tasset hinges, and a 3-joint Caduceus Resonance Healing Staff. Styled with pearl-white ceramic armour paints, hex-weave carbon-fibre undersuit, brushed titanium, gold trim, custom SVG HUD visor/shield/badge textures, and self-lit golden/cyan hard-light emitters.
data.flaws: None known; all parts are anchored to skeleton bones with low-poly segment budgets to avoid fine-mesh warnings, and boot soles plus staff ferrule rest cleanly on y = 0.
data.name: Valkyrie-7 Cyborg Medic
data.description: Overwatch-style support-hero cyborg medic with articulated cybernetic limbs, hard-light biotic wings, nanite reservoirs, and a caduceus resonance healing staff.
